notes.title: DLC Release! The DLC release featuring a new map and a host of fresh anomalies!
notes.notes: Embark on thrilling adventures in uncharted territories and brace yourself for new challenges. Have you had the opportunity to delve into the new content yet? https://store.steampowered.com/app/2963820/Project_13_Nightwatch__Canteen/

notes.title: New Map and 35 New Anomalies
notes.notes: Embark on a new mission within the mysterious confines of Project 13 with the latest expansion pack for Nightwatch. Having patrolled the Gate Area, you now stand watch in the heart of Project 13 HQ and the bustling Canteed. Your duty remains steadfast: to ensure no anomalies evade detection and to maintain the security of the facility. The Nightwatch rests solely in your hands.

notes.title: Big Update!
notes.notes: Big Update! Now the Hardcore Mode is available to play! All captured Observers will have different colors, body shapes, and sizes. The weather changes, and there's 0 mercy for reporting an innocent captured Observer! Besides Hardcore, the UI is updated to Chinese simplified language, and the brightness during the game is optimized.

notes.title: NEW MAP AND ANOMALIES ARE COMING SOON!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Nightwatch Operatives!

So excited to announce the upcoming update for Project 13 Nightwatch! Get ready to dive deeper into the mysteries of the Nightwatch Observer with a brand-new map, continuing the gripping narrative from Project 13 HQ.

New Map: The Nightwatch Observer
Explore the intricacies of the Nightwatch Observer as you venture into the new map in the HQ of the Project 13 Facility.

New Anomalies
Prepare yourselves for encounters with new anomalies lurking in the darkness. Stay vigilant as you navigate the ever-changing landscape of the Nightwatch Observer.

Fixes and Improvements
We've been hard at work addressing your feedback and fine-tuning the game experience. Expect various fixes and improvements to enhance your gameplay.

Continuous Content Development
Our commitment to delivering exciting new content never wavers. Working around the clock to bring you more thrilling adventures and experiences. Stay tuned for what's to come!

Get ready to embark on another thrilling journey with Project 13 Nightwatch. Keep your eyes peeled for the update, and remember to stay sharp, stay focused, and stay vigilant. The Nightwatch never sleeps.

Stay tuned for more updates!

-The Project 13 Nightwatch Dev

notes.title: Added HOW TO PLAY INFO
notes.notes:
Added HOW TO PLAY INFO:
INFO: Search with the Binoculars for Anomalies. They can be hidden, either as a captured Observer or in the environment. Keep an eye on the details. This is NOT an easy task. If you find nothing and believe "all is good," press Space so all captured Observers will walk back to HQ. If the Green Light glows up at HQ, you did it right... If it's Red, have a guess... Use the E key to fast forward after making your Target Report, so you don't need to wait as long for them to return to HQ. You also have Night Vision available with the Q key; use it to gain an advantage during dark nights, as some anomalies are only visible with Night Vision. You're gonna make it!
